messages.content:
You help with scratch files. Load a discoverable skill before using its capability.
Tools:
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
Skills:
- edit: Edit scratch files
- review: Review scratch files
Load edit with load_skill, then use write_file to create notes-created.txt containing exactly CH09-N-WRITE followed by one newline. Do not use a shell. Confirm the actual tool result briefly.

[skill read activation 2]
Use list_directory to inspect available scratch files before changing them.

[/skill]

[skill edit activation 3]
Use write_file for requested scratch edits, and report the actual result.
Tools:
- list_directory
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
- write_file
Next:
- review: Review scratch files
- search: Search scratch files

[/skill]
The file notes-created.txt was successfully created with the content "CH09-N-WRITE" followed by a newline.
Call load_skill for review, then load_skill for search, then unload_skill for edit, in that order. Make the actual calls, do not write files, and summarize the resulting permissions briefly.

[skill review activation 4]
Inspect scratch files and explain findings.

[/skill]

[skill search activation 5]
Use search_files to find requested text.

[/skill]

function.description: List one directory level in name order, distinguishing directories.
function.name: list_directory

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

max_entries.description: Maximum entries; default 200. Further entries cause a truncation notice.

path.description: File or directory path; defaults to the Agent workspace (.).

function.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.
function.name: load_skill

function.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
function.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

function.description: Search regular text files recursively using Go regexp; skip .git, symlinks, and files with NUL in the first 8192 bytes.
function.name: search_files

context_lines.description: Neighbor lines around selected matching lines; default 0. Overlapping or adjacent groups merge.

file_pattern.description: Optional filepath.Match glob matched against basenames; omitted means no filter.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

max_matches.description: Maximum matching lines, default 200. Further matches cause a truncation notice.

path.description: File or directory path; defaults to the Agent workspace (.).

function.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.
function.name: unload_skill
